pileup.name: pileup
pileup.input: BAM file containing base modification tags (MM/ML)
pileup.description: Tabulates base modification calls across genomic positions. Converts modBAM to bedMethyl format with per-base modification statistics. Supports filtering, strand combining, CpG restriction, and presets.
output_column_descriptions: chrom: reference sequence name from BAM header
modified base code: single-letter code for modified base
score: equal to Nvalid_cov (used for visualization)
strand: '+' or '-' or '.' when strands are combined
Nvalid_cov: number of valid calls (Nmod + Ncanonical + Nother_mod)
Nother_mod: modified calls of a different modification code
Ndelete: reads with deletion at position
Nnocall: reads aligned but lacking modification call

adjust-mods.name: adjust-mods
adjust-mods.output: BAM file with adjusted modification codes
adjust-mods.description: Converts or removes specific base modification codes in BAM files. Can ignore selected modification calls or recode them for downstream compatibility.

update-tags.name: update-tags
update-tags.description: Renames legacy Mm/Ml tags to MM/ML and normalizes mode flags ('.' or '?'). Ensures BAM files conform to SAM v1.7 modified-base tag specification.

sample-probs.name: sample-probs
sample-probs.description: Samples and reports the probability distribution of modification calls. Useful for visualizing model calibration and threshold selection.
output_column_descriptions: mod_code: modification symbol (e.g. m, h, a)
count: number of calls within the bin

summary.name: summary
summary.description: Summarizes modification tags present in BAM. Produces totals (# prefix) and modification-call tables with per-base statistics.
output_column_descriptions: total_reads_used: number of reads with mod calls
count_reads_{base}: number of reads per canonical base
code: modification code or '-' for canonical
pass_count: number of high-confidence calls (= threshold)

call-mods.name: call-mods
call-mods.description: Calls modified vs canonical bases, producing a new modBAM with 100% or 0% probabilities based on binary classification of modification state.

extract.name: extract
extract.description: Extracts read-level base modification information from a modBAM file, producing a TSV with positions, probabilities, and modification context.

repair.name: repair
repair.description: Repairs missing or corrupted MM/ML tags in one BAM using a donor BAM that contains correct tags. Requires read name-sorted BAMs and superset donor reads.

dmr.name: dmr
dmr.output: BED file of DMRs with score column
dmr.description: Performs differential methylation analysis (DMR test) across predefined regions. Outputs a BED file with per-region scores reflecting modification differences.
output_column_descriptions: delta_mod: estimated difference in modification level

pileup-hemi.name: pileup-hemi
pileup-hemi.description: Tabulates double-stranded base modification patterns, such as hemi-methylation, across genomic motifs. Outputs a bedMethyl-formatted file describing strand-specific methylation.
output_column_descriptions: chrom, start, end, mod_code, score, strand (as in pileup)
hemi_ratio: fraction of reads showing hemi-modification
Nfull: number of fully methylated reads

validate.name: validate
validate.input: set of modBAMs and BED truth files
validate.description: Validates modification calls by comparing to ground-truth modification status. Reports per-site accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores.
output_column_descriptions: tp, fp, tn, fn: confusion matrix counts

motif.name: motif
motif.output: BED or TSV motif enrichment results
motif.description: Searches for or refines sequence motifs enriched in modification sites. Can output BED locations of motifs or statistical enrichment tables.
output_column_descriptions: mod_fraction: fraction modified at motif sites

entropy.name: entropy
entropy.output: bedGraph or TSV table of methylation entropy
entropy.description: Calculates methylation entropy over genomic windows, indicating modification heterogeneity within a region.
output_column_descriptions: coverage: number of reads per window

localize.name: localize
localize.input: modBAM file and genomic feature BED
localize.description: Aggregates modification pileup counts around genomic features (e.g., TSS, enhancers), to investigate positional modification enrichment patterns.

stats.name: stats
stats.input: modBAM file and optional BED region file
stats.description: Calculates modification levels, coverage, and ratios over specified genomic regions. Useful for region-level quantification of methylation or other modifications.
output_column_descriptions: Nreads: number of reads covering region

bedmethyl.name: bedmethyl
bedmethyl.description: Provides utilities for manipulating bedMethyl files, including merging, reformatting, and subsetting based on modification type or coverage.

modbam.name: modbam
modbam.description: Provides low-level utilities for working with modBAMs: filtering, conversion, and inspection of modification tags (MM/ML).

open-chromatin.name: open-chromatin
open-chromatin.output: BED file of open chromatin regions
open-chromatin.description: Identifies open chromatin regions based on exogenous 6mA signal, outputting BED-formatted regions with scores representing accessibility.
output_column_descriptions: score: 6mA enrichment signal (proxy for chromatin accessibility)
